A Study to Evaluate Rucaparib in Participants With Solid Tumors and With Deleterious Mutations in HRR Genes
examples.why: The study was terminated due to a change in development priorities.

summary: A small computer program, rather than tests done on people, predicted a high score for liver issues and a medium score for heart issues for Rucaparib Camsylate [M]. Two research studies involving this drug were stopped early [3]. One trial in patients with prostate cancer was stopped because it ran out of funding [4]. Another trial for participants with solid tumors was ended because the developers changed their priorities [5].
